## RSVP Ads Campaign Manager
Rules + AI-reviewer. Hard limits: ≤₪400/mo ad spend, no site spend, never pause converting keywords, website changes as GitHub PRs only.

### Before enabling the schedule
1. Wire credentials into the HTTP nodes (Google Ads OAuth2 + developer-token header; Ollama at http://localhost:11434; GitHub PAT).
2. Set CUSTOMER_ID / CAMPAIGN_ID / BUDGET_ID / AD_GROUP_ID in the Code nodes.
3. Keep 'Validate & Gate' DRY_RUN=true until the reports look right for a few days.

Queries: see automation/gaql-and-api.md · Rules: automation/rules-engine.js · Prompt: automation/ai-reviewer-prompt.md

parameters.jsonBody: ={ "query": "SELECT campaign.id, campaign.name, campaign.status, campaign_budget.amount_micros, metrics.cost_micros, metrics.conversions, metrics.clicks FROM campaign WHERE campaign.name = 'RSVP Search Campaign' AND segments.date DURING THIS_MONTH" }

parameters.content:
### READ (3 GAQL queries)
Duplicate this node for the Keyword (LAST_30_DAYS), Keyword-90d (winner protection), and Search-terms queries in gaql-and-api.md, then feed all into 'Normalize'.

### ACT (only when DRY_RUN=false)
Add HTTP mutate nodes per gaql-and-api.md: adGroupCriteria:mutate (pause kw), campaignCriteria:mutate (add negative), campaignBudgets:mutate (budget), campaigns:mutate (pause at cap). Branch each off 'Validate & Gate' by action type.

### PROPOSE (website)
If websitePR != null → GitHub node: create a branch + PR on muaddibbb/rsvp-platform. Never deploy.
